# Sabin Paudel

> Frontend developer from Pokhara, Nepal, specializing in React, Next.js, and TypeScript.

## About

Sabin Paudel is a frontend developer based in Pokhara, Nepal. He builds fast, accessible, and modern web applications using React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. He currently works as a Frontend Developer at YHHITS, contributing to production React and Next.js applications.

## Skills

- Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- Backend: Node.js, Express, MongoDB
- Tools: Git, Figma, Postman, Linux

## Projects

- [SlangHub](https://slanghub.vercel.app/): A community-driven Gen Z slang dictionary built with Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase, and Tailwind CSS.
- [CivicEye](https://civic-eye-frontend-liart.vercel.app): A location-aware civic issue reporting platform built with React, TypeScript, Maps, and Geolocation.
- [Zone XVI Community Website](https://zonexvi.vercel.app): A community website for event discovery and club profiles, built with React.
- [Secure Document Signing Platform](https://sign.sabinpaudel.com.np): A digital signature platform with verification and audit trails, built with React, Node.js, and MongoDB.
